notes: The board's certification of a question voted on in several counties, as the county with the most voters in it, listed with its results on its page (https://boe.cuyahogacounty.gov/elections/GetElectionById/229/); each county's figures are as it printed them.

The Cuyahoga County Board of Elections's own file, listed under the general election on its page (https://boe.cuyahogacounty.gov/elections/GetElectionById/229/); fetched once and kept in states_cache/oh_local/results/20201103/cuyahoga/. The board's server pads the file with zero bytes after its end; they are set aside.

The Franklin County Board of Elections's own file, listed under the general election on its page (https://vote.franklincountyohio.gov/Election-Info/2020); fetched once and kept in states_cache/oh_local/results/20201103/franklin/.

The Secretary's own file address answers scripts with a Cloudflare challenge, so the workbook was read from the Internet Archive's capture of that address taken 2020-11-27 (https://web.archive.org/web/20201127195210id_/https://www.ohiosos.gov/globalassets/elections/2020/gen/statewideresultsbycounty.xlsx), saved on 2026-10-02 and read here from disk; the SHA-256 is the saved file's. Marked 'Official Canvass' in its own title row.
